title: Orthogonal Spectral, Thermal and Geodetic Evidence Streams: A Reproducible Python Framework for Quantile-Harmonised Archive Analytics, Explainable Surface-State Learning and Kinematic Attribution

creators.name: Lemenkova, Polina
creators.affiliation: BRGM; Le Studium; Laboratoire PRISME, Université d'Orléans / INSA CVL

description: ROI-agnostic Python framework fusing quantile-harmonised Landsat C2L2 SR/ST and Sentinel-2 L2A stacks, spatially blocked RF/GBDT surface-state inference with TreeSHAP attribution, Hamed-Rao Mann-Kendall / Theil-Sen / PELT change diagnostics, robust-z LST anomalies with Moran's I and LISA, and Sentinel-1 SBAS (HyP3-MintPy) kinematic attribution.
